en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a rural European village. In the foreground is an open grassy field. Beyond it runs a road lined with small trees and a low fence. Behind the trees stand several gabled houses with tiled roofs and shuttered windows. A horse‑drawn cart and a few people are visible on the road. In the background, partly obscured by trees and roofs, rises the tower of a church with a bulbous (onion-shaped) dome. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
